status: GPU geometry operators and five-layer native integration validated; measured speedups and regressions disclosed. Host topology, control and mirrors remain.

architecture.applications: gasUGKP remains pure flow; CHT conjugate heat; CHMT conjugate heat/mass transfer and ablation. Generic shared CUDA operators; no case-specific production dispatch.
device_operators: extended-range wall triangle distance, parallel wall queries per cell
cooperative resident harmonic Jacobi and row-pivoted twice-reorthogonalized QR
sweep and planarity linearization, ordered resident correction accumulation
surface edge geometry and adaptive Gauss-Legendre integration
batched face/cell/wall rebuild and 64 MiB indexed exact LRU query reuse
host_work: topology/canonical interface maps and CSR metadata
analytic trajectory certificates and host floating-point trial environment
some low-cost surface fields, stage interpolation and geometry budget arithmetic
OpenFOAM field/checkpoint/output mirrors, MPI and ordered diagnostic publication remain on the host; this is not a claim of zero CPU execution.
arithmetic: FP64 with contraction disabled; original within-face, within-cell and neighbor summation order.
Harmonic Jacobi iteration and row-pivoted QR retain original iteration, pivot, rank, tolerance, two-pass reorthogonalization and compatibility policies.

Original extended-range triangle-distance formulas use scaled double-double arithmetic (~106-bit significand with a separate exponent) on CUDA; this is not a claim of bitwise equivalence to x86 long double for all inputs.
Geometric faces/cells/Simpson sweeps, planarity/derivative polynomials, boundary recession and adaptive edge quadrature retain original formulas.

The 64 MiB bounded indexed LRU cache reuses GPU-computed rebuild results only for exactly matching topology, bitwise point coordinates and ordered wall lists. Hash collisions undergo exact checks; every miss executes GPU operators. No tolerance, case identity or physical-regime selectors.
architecture.floating_point_scope: Native CUDA geometry validated under default round-to-nearest; host exception flags and nondefault rounding modes are not emulated. Original CPU frontend retains its host fenv contract.
architecture.requirements: No README edits, new physical stopping gates, runtime CPU fallback, solver role changes or case-specific production branches.
